Our Open Opportunities

R&D

System & DevOps Engineer

SeeTrue is an exciting Artificial Intelligence well funded startup in the heart of Tel Aviv, we are leveraging Machine Learning and Computer Vision to bring AI to optimize passenger journeys, making security screening accurate, fast and labor free.

We are seeking a System & DevOps Engineer to join our DevOps and IT team.

Responsibilities:

  • Continuously improve our infrastructure to be more secure, scalable, and robust
  • Apply new technologies for internal and external services
  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and IaC for our infrastructure
  • Control and develop the monitoring and observability solutions
  • Manage and maintain the company’s IT infrastructure, including both Ubuntu and Windows workstations, servers, and networking equipment
  • Provide technical support to the team, ensuring minimal disruption to daily operations

Requirements:

  • 4-6 years of experience as a DevOps engineer
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible / Terraform or other provisioning tools
  • Hands-on experience with containers (Docker/Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab
  • Hands-on experience in production environments
  • Hands-on experience working with cloud environments
  • Scripting ability – Bash / Python / Groovy or PowerShell
  • Strong background in Linux systems administration

Advantages:

  • Familiarity with storage systems, backups, and monitoring tools
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered DevOps tools
  • Understanding of networking technologies (ex: TCP/IP, DNS, VPN)
  • Proficiency in cybersecurity tools and techniques (e.g., firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM)
  • Security best practices and compliance knowledge

Sales

Regional Sales Director, APAC

Join SeeTrue and help shape the future of security screening worldwide. We’re a fast-growing AI company using machine learning and computer vision to make security screening smarter, faster, and more effective.

We are looking for an experienced, commercially driven sales professional to grow SeeTrue’s presence across Asia-Pacific. This role offers significant ownership of the region, with a focus on developing new business, building strong customer and partner relationships, and driving long-term commercial growth.

What You’ll Own:

  • Drive sales and business development across priority APAC markets
  • Build a strong pipeline and own the full sales cycle, from opportunity development through negotiation, closing, and account expansion
  • Develop long-term relationships with airports, government agencies, security authorities, and other key customers
  • Identify and develop new markets, strategic accounts, and regional opportunities
  • Build strong relationships with distributors, OEMs, integrators, and other regional partners
  • Represent SeeTrue at customer meetings, industry events, and conferences across APAC
  • Provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and customer feedback to support business and product decisions
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and technical teams to support opportunities and successful execution
  • Travel regularly across the region

What We’re Looking For:

  • Proven B2B/B2G sales experience in security screening, aviation security, or critical infrastructure across APAC
  • Experience selling to airports, government agencies, security authorities, or other complex institutional customers
  • Solid understanding of X-ray and/or CT security screening systems
  • Demonstrated success in developing new markets, building pipelines, and closing complex, high-value deals
  • Strong relationships and experience within the APAC security ecosystem
  • Experience working with distributors, OEMs, integrators, or other channel partners
  • Ability to navigate complex sales cycles involving commercial, technical, and regulatory stakeholders
  • Hands-on, commercially driven, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Excellent business-level English

 

This is an opportunity to take significant ownership of SeeTrue’s growth across APAC and play a key role in shaping our presence in the region.

Apply now and help us redefine security screening with AI.

APAC Solution Engineer

We are looking for a hands-on, business-oriented, and highly motivated Solution Engineer to own the technical customer journey across both pre-sales and post-sales activities.

You will work closely with customers throughout the entire lifecycle, from understanding technical requirements, designing solutions, and leading demonstrations and PoCs, through implementation, integration, troubleshooting, and ongoing technical support.

You will work at the intersection of technology, customers, and business, partnering closely with Sales, Product, R&D, Delivery, and Customer Success.

Location:

APAC region – this role is open to candidates across the APAC region and is not tied to a specific country.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical relationship with customers across the pre-sales and post-sales lifecycle
  • Lead technical pre-sales activities, including customer discovery, solution design, product demonstrations, technical presentations, and deep-dive sessions
  • Understand customer environments, technical requirements, business processes, and challenges to design and propose the right solution.
    Take full ownership of Proof of Concept (PoC) activities, including technical setup, execution, troubleshooting, analysis, and presentation of results
  • Support post-sales implementation and integration, working hands-on with customers to ensure successful deployment and adoption of the solution
  • Troubleshoot technical and system-level issues, working directly with customers and coordinating with R&D, Product, Delivery, and Customer Success when needed
  • Serve as a trusted technical point of contact for customers throughout the customer lifecycle
  • Analyze reports and statistical data to derive insights, identify issues, and support customer discussions
  • Support Sales with technical proposals, solution architecture, and customer-facing materials
  • Provide continuous feedback to the Product and R&D teams regarding customer requirements, technical gaps, product performance, and market needs
  • Travel approximately 40% of the time.

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of experience in Solution Engineering, Presales/Post-Sales Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Customer Success, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Strong hands-on technical background in IT and computer systems, including areas such as networking, operating systems, system integration, infrastructure, and troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to work directly with customers on both technical sales processes and post-sales implementation/support.
  • Ability to understand complex technical environments, diagnose issues, and independently drive solutions.
  • Strong customer engagement, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Business-oriented mindset with the ability to translate technical capabilities into customer value.
  • Self-driven, hands-on, and comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field – an advantage.
  • Experience in the HLS (Homeland Security) domain – an advantage.
  • Foreign passport – an advantage.This role may require a background check and/or security clearance, in accordance with applicable regulations.
